description:
CROSS-REPO — owned and built in AGORA/LUGH (the F3 providers), not koine. Delivers the finetune-job SEMANTIC admission rules the schema cannot express: modality x method compatibility (FT-F), egress/license aggregation over {data union base} (FT-B), inline-header checks (FT-N..P) — pinned by the finetune scenarios (scenarios/e2e-finetune.md, e2e-producer-exhaust-finetune.md). koine holds the scenarios + finetune-job.schema.json; the semantic gate runtime is downstream (ADR-0001) and lives with the F3 providers (chief/57 general, chief/58 specialist). Tracked here as a koine ROADMAP Phase F5 marker ('agora/lugh chief/66-finetune-semantic-admission'). PARKED in koine: placeholder; move to the provider repos' tasks/chief/ to activate.

DOWNSTREAM COUNTERPART (authored 2026-08-19): agora:79-finetune-semantic-admission and lugh:400-adopt-finetune-semantic-admission. This record is the marker, not the work. Retire it with supersededBy naming that tasklist once it merges — nothing in chief does this automatically.

userStories.title: Semantic admission rules the schema cannot express
userStories.description: In the F3 provider repos, implement the finetune-job semantic gate: modality x method compatibility, egress/license aggregation, inline-header checks. koine ROADMAP marker; downstream per ADR-0001.
acceptanceCriteria: Implemented in agora/lugh (not koine): the finetune-job gate enforces the SEMANTIC rules the KFT §3 schema cannot express — modality x method compatibility (FT-F, e.g. reject dpo on text-to-image), egress/license aggregation over {data union base} (FT-B), and the inline dataset-jsonl-header checks (FT-N..P) — before any compute, per fine-tuning.md §3/§4.

The rules are pinned by koine's finetune scenarios (scenarios/e2e-finetune.md, scenarios/e2e-producer-exhaust-finetune.md); they layer on top of the syntactic validator (chief/60) and conform to koine's KFT contract by reference (ADR-0001).
Runs under the provider repos' own gates; no koine file is edited by this tasklist.
userStories.notes: Cross-repo (agora/lugh). Parked in koine as a ROADMAP F5 marker.
